steps.title: Establish the annual commissioning model and Year 1 portfolio
steps.summary: Establish the annual commissioning model for 2.2.4 and translate the Year 1 portfolio ambition into four thematic workpackages. Set the portfolio-level investment, deduplicated reach, student-hours and depth ambition, then give each workpackage a defined investment envelope and devolved responsibility for contributing to those targets. Confirm named ownership where still TBC and establish the shared delivery rhythm and common planning frame of scalable evergreen, short active and sustained intensive provision.

outputs.title: Annual commissioning model
outputs.summary: A repeatable annual model in which 2.2.4 holds the overall investment envelope, deduplicated student reach, student-hours and portfolio balance, while a small number of thematic workpackages receive devolved responsibility for defined contributions. The thematic mix can change each year as need and evidence evolve.

outputs.title: Final-Year Career Enhancement workpackage
outputs.owner: Careers and Employability Service, named owner TBC
outputs.summary: £50,000 Year 1 envelope; approximately 700 distinct final-year students, around 10% of the graduating undergraduate population; approximately 10,000 to 12,000 student-hours; around 150 sustained high-intensity places. The workpackage combines scalable and short active provision with projects, placements, mentoring and other deeper career-enhancing experiences.

outputs.title: Entrepreneurship and Enterprise Experience workpackage
outputs.summary: £40,000 Year 1 envelope; approximately 800 distinct students; approximately 7,000 to 9,000 student-hours; around 100 sustained high-intensity places. The workpackage combines scalable enterprise capability, short active challenge and prototyping activity, and a deeper pathway into venture-building, social enterprise, live briefs and longer enterprise projects.

outputs.title: Belonging and Connection workpackage
outputs.summary: £30,000 Year 1 envelope; approximately 1,500 distinct students and around 1,800 participation instances; approximately 3,500 to 4,500 student-hours. The workpackage is predominantly short and active, with a smaller deeper participatory or sandpit-style layer and repeat participation encouraged where it strengthens connection and belonging.

outputs.title: Service and Community-Engaged Experience workpackage
outputs.summary: £30,000 Year 1 envelope; approximately 600 distinct students; approximately 6,000 to 8,000 student-hours; around 100 sustained high-intensity places. The workpackage combines accessible community-engaged entry points and short active projects with deeper projects, placements and partner-based experiences.

decisions.title: Confirm named Careers owner for the Final-Year Career Enhancement workpackage
decisions.summary: Confirm the accountable workpackage owner within Careers and Employability before substantive commissioning begins.

decisions.title: Confirm owner for the Entrepreneurship and Enterprise Experience workpackage
decisions.summary: Confirm the accountable workpackage owner for the entrepreneurship and enterprise commissioning envelope before substantive commissioning begins.

newInvestment.rationale: Funds the first annual portfolio, devolved across four thematic workpackages: £50,000 Final-Year Career Enhancement, £40,000 Entrepreneurship and Enterprise Experience, £30,000 Belonging and Connection, and £30,000 Service and Community-Engaged Experience. The portfolio is designed to establish both substantive annual provision and the first reusable evergreen assets needed for later growth.
newInvestment.riskIfMissing: King's Edge cannot establish the first annual commissioning portfolio or create the reusable opportunity base required for the planned three-year growth trajectory.

steps.title: Deliver and learn from the Year 1 portfolio
steps.summary: Deliver the four Year 1 thematic workpackages against a single portfolio-level ambition. Workpackage owners hold devolved responsibility for their agreed contribution, while 2.2.4 tracks deduplicated reach across the portfolio, student-hours, repeat participation, the balance of scalable evergreen, short active and sustained intensive provision, delivery quality and access. Use Year 1 to establish the first reusable asset base and to identify what should grow, reshape, stop or be newly commissioned in Year 2.

outputs.title: Year 1 portfolio reach and engagement
outputs.summary: At least 2,500 distinct students, around 6% of the current King's student population, engage in substantive beyond-course opportunities across the Year 1 portfolio. Package-level planning anticipates approximately 26,500 to 33,500 student-hours overall and around 350 sustained high-intensity places, with package-level reach intentionally summing above the deduplicated portfolio target because students may participate in more than one workpackage.
acceptanceCriteria: At least 2,500 distinct students are recorded across the Year 1 portfolio after deduplication between workpackages.

outputs.title: Year 1 portfolio review and Year 2 thematic commissioning plan
outputs.summary: A concise evidence-led review of reach, repeat participation, student-hours, delivery mix, access, evergreen asset creation and unmet demand, followed by a Year 2 portfolio that sets the £200,000 envelope and devolves its contributions through the thematic workpackages best suited to the next year’s priorities.

steps.title: Grow the Year 2 commissioning portfolio
steps.summary: Grow the second annual portfolio using evidence from Year 1 while reusing and improving the evergreen courses, projects and other scalable assets already created. Set a new annual thematic workpackage mix and devolve responsibility for contributions to the overall £200,000 investment, reach, student-hours and depth ambition. Increase the breadth of low-friction entry points, use short active experiences to convert more initial engagement into substantive participation, and expand sustained intensive capacity where evidence and partner capacity support it.

outputs.title: Year 2 thematic commissioning portfolio
outputs.summary: A small set of thematic workpackages with defined envelopes and devolved contributions to a portfolio ambition of at least 4,000 distinct students, around 9% of the current King's student population, approximately 55,000 to 65,000 student-hours and around 500 sustained high-intensity places. The thematic mix is informed by Year 1 evidence rather than assumed to remain identical to Year 1.

newInvestment.fundingRoute: King's Edge Year 2 mobilisation investment request
newInvestment.rationale: Builds on the Year 1 portfolio by commissioning additional provision, increasing enrolment into reusable evergreen opportunities and expanding active and sustained capacity. The model expects reach and student-hours to grow faster than annual expenditure as the reusable asset base matures.
newInvestment.riskIfMissing: The portfolio will be unable to convert its Year 1 foundations into the planned step-change in reach, depth and reusable opportunity supply.

steps.title: Scale the Year 3 commissioning portfolio
steps.summary: Scale the third annual portfolio on top of two years of accumulated evergreen provision and delivery learning. Refresh the annual thematic workpackage mix against evolving student need and future-facing evidence, while driving substantially greater enrolment into reusable skills courses, self-directed programmes and repeatable projects. Grow short active provision where it creates effective progression into deeper activity, while sustained intensive capacity reaches a planned plateau.

outputs.title: Year 3 portfolio at institutional scale
outputs.summary: A £250,000 annual portfolio, devolved through the thematic workpackages most relevant to Year 3 need, reaches at least 6,500 distinct students, around 15% of the current King's student population, generates approximately 100,000 to 115,000 student-hours and supports around 600 sustained high-intensity places. Growth is increasingly generated by the accumulated evergreen asset base as well as new annual commissioning.

newInvestment.fundingRoute: King's Edge Year 3 mobilisation investment request
newInvestment.rationale: Funds the final mobilisation-year expansion of the commissioned portfolio, combining new opportunity creation with large-scale reuse of evergreen assets and a mature sustained high-intensity layer.
newInvestment.riskIfMissing: The portfolio will not reach the intended institutional scale or build the mature reusable asset base required for a lower-cost business-as-usual model.

steps.title: Transition to steady-state opportunity commissioning
steps.summary: Transition from mobilisation investment to an enduring annual commissioning model that sustains and refreshes the accumulated opportunity portfolio rather than recreating it from scratch. Continue to set portfolio-level ambitions and devolve delivery through a responsive annual mix of thematic workpackages. Grow enrolment through mature evergreen entry points and short active opportunities while protecting the high-touch sustained intensive layer at around 600 places. Recurring investment focuses on refresh, facilitation, responsive new commissioning and the people-intensive provision that cannot be scaled through reuse alone.

outputs.title: Steady-state commissioning model
outputs.summary: An enduring portfolio supported by an indicative £175,000 annual business-as-usual investment, reaching around 9,000 distinct students, approximately 20% of the current King's student population, generating approximately 145,000 to 165,000 student-hours and maintaining around 600 sustained high-intensity places. The annual thematic mix remains responsive, while the model explicitly relies on the reusable opportunity assets built during the three mobilisation years.

newInvestment.item: Annual business-as-usual beyond-course opportunity commissioning requirement
newInvestment.rationale: Provides the recurring annual funding needed to sustain and refresh the mature portfolio, protect around 600 sustained high-intensity places, facilitate active provision and selectively commission new opportunities while continuing to exploit the reusable evergreen asset base created during mobilisation.
newInvestment.riskIfMissing: The accumulated evergreen portfolio will lose currency and delivery support, while the people-intensive layer will contract, undermining the intended steady-state reach and depth.
